def run():
    size = int(input())
    numbers = []
    for _ in range(size):
        val = int(input())
        numbers.append(val)
    numbers.sort()
    max_diff = int(input())
    max_count = 0
    left_pointer = -1
    right_pointer = 0
    while right_pointer != size:
        left_pointer += 1
        while right_pointer < size and numbers[right_pointer] - numbers[left_pointer] <= max_diff:
            right_pointer += 1
        max_count = max(max_count, right_pointer - left_pointer)
    print(max_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    run()
